results.steps: Admin 1366x900, #/users > New user; username/full name/password/role filled. (a) Email 'not-an-email' > Save. (b) Typed a 132-char email > Save. (c) Email = another user's email in upper case (WM-DUP-...@RT.LOCAL) > Save.
results.expected: Readable field message instead of 'One or more fields are invalid'; duplicate (other case) email shows 'Email already exists'.
results.actual: (a) Red text above Save/Cancel: 'Email must be a well-formed email address'. (b) The Email field stops at 120 characters (the 132-char value is cut to 120 'a's, no @), so Save shows the same 'Email must be a well-formed email address'; an over-120 email cannot be typed. (c) 'Email already exists'. The dialog stays open each time and no user is created (API: 0 users with that username). POST /api/users returned 400 each time.

results.expected: 'Role name already exists' visible by Save/Cancel without scrolling the privilege list.
results.actual: 'Role name already exists' in red at y=780, directly above Cancel/Save (y=833), below the privilege list (which scrolls on its own). POST /api/roles 400 {message:'Role name already exists'}.

results.steps: Admin, #/payments > Record payment, customer wm-pay (primary Collection POC pre-filled). Amount 10.555 > Record; then Amount 10.55, Method Cash > Record. The field values were read back before each Record.
results.expected: 10.555 refused in the dialog with a 2-decimal-places message; 10.55 records.
results.actual: With Amount *=10.555 the dialog shows 'Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most 2 decimal places' and sends no POST (payments for the customer unchanged). With 10.55 the dialog closes, POST /api/payments {amount:10.55} and payment #180 is stored as 10.55. (The first run, g1.js, is void: the typed 10.555 landed in the Method field (harness click on stale positions) and produced payment #179 = 10.55 with method '10.555'.)

results.steps: Tried a 1500-char reason: POST /api/disputes -> 409 'This change conflicts with existing data' (see observations), so two 1000-char reasons were used (one with spaces, one unbroken). Admin 1366: #/disputes?f=customerId:eq:330, hover the reason; #/notifications, hover the message. Also #/disputes at 1920.
results.expected: Disputes table stays within the screen; reason cut with an ellipsis; hover shows the full text.
results.actual: Much narrower than before (Open action at x≈1614 instead of ≈4227), but at 1366 the table still does not fit: the Reason column starts at x≈1150 and is cut by the window edge, so its ellipsis and the Open action are off-screen until you scroll sideways (the always-visible scrollbar is shown). At 1920 everything fits: Reason capped at 1337-1790 px, two lines ending in '…', Open at 1839. Hovering a reason shows a tooltip with the full text ending '-END'. Notifications at 1366: Title ellipsised, Message capped (~360 px, two lines, '…'), tooltip with the full text; Type and Received visible, only the Read column (x 1387-1489) is off-screen.
results.note: D-20's own expectation (cells capped, ellipsis, full text on hover) is met. Only this check's 'stays within the screen' at 1366 fails.
results.likely_cause: The column widths add up to more than the ~1110 px beside the rail at 1366: Target ~290 + Customer ~212 + Status ~141 + Opened ~197 + Reason capped at 360 (disputes_screen.dart:55, maxWidth: 360) + padding + checkbox + action column. Only Reason is capped; Target is not.

observations.title: Dispute reasons of 1001-2000 characters fail with a generic 409
observations.detail: POST /api/disputes as a customer: 1000 chars -> 200, 1001 and 2000 -> 409 'This change conflicts with existing data', 2001 -> 400 'must be at most 2000 characters'. The request allows 2000 (DisputeDtos.java:16, FieldLimits.DISPUTE_TEXT = 2000), but the reason is also copied into the admin notification message (DisputeService.java:82-85 -> Notification.java:33 @Column(length = 1000)). So a 1500-char reason (the one this run was asked to use) cannot be saved, and the user gets no hint why. API only; not tried through the dialog.
observations.evidence: probe in this run; setup.js reason1500 {status:409}

observations.title: Sign-out fires a 401 on the table schema
observations.detail: At sign-out the app sends GET /api/table-schemas/invoices without a token -> 401. tableSchemaProvider now watches the user id (table_providers.dart:42), so the id changing to null at logout (auth_controller.dart:62-64) refetches the schema of the open list. Nothing visible (clean login screen), but it is a wasted request that could trip an expired-session handler.

observations.title: Past-the-end pager still reads 'Page 100 of 24'
observations.detail: The row range is now '0–0 of 469', but the page label keeps the out-of-range page number next to the past-the-end message.

observations.title: At 1366 most admin lists need a sideways scroll to reach row actions
observations.detail: Invoices (Sales POC + actions), Customers (Success/Collection POC + actions), Payments (Collection POC + Open), Users (Edit), Promises (Override status), Notifications (Read column). The scrollbar is visible and works. The POC columns are wide (Invoices Sales POC ≈327 px).

observations.title: Row checkboxes are not in the accessibility tree
observations.detail: Table row checkboxes are drawn and clickable, but flt-semantics exposes no checkbox nodes for them (only the filter chips show as checkbox), so tests and probably screen readers can't find them. Low confidence on the screen-reader impact.

observations.title: Unknown-path page has no app shell
